announcements.title: Thank you for the survey
announcements.body:
Thank you to everyone who answered the survey.

The post covers:

- What you told me about your Mac, your problems, and your wishes
- What changes in version 1.0.0, such as the resizable game window and the battery saver
- The new ARM64 runtime by riverfog7, which used about 43% less CPU in my tests
- Where I need help: guides, translations, and testing

Version 1.0.0 is not out yet.

announcements.title: Help shape the future of Arknights Client
announcements.body:
I want to know how Arknights Client works on your Mac. Your answers help me shape the future development of the app.

The survey asks about:

- Your Mac, display setup, and macOS version
- Performance and problems
- Updates and features you want

The survey is anonymous and takes about 4 minutes. It does not ask for your name or email address. The launcher sends no data to the survey.

Please answer only once. This message appears only once.
